FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited 
Quarter ended September 30, 2026 – Media Press Release 
 
Nykaa delivers strong Q2 FY2027 performance; consolidated Net revenue up 28% YoY, PAT up 207% YoY 
 
FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited (referred to as “Nykaa” or the “Company”), today announced its financial results for the 
quarter ended September 30, 2026 
 
Q2 FY2027 FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS SUMMARY: 
 
• 
Consolidated GMV grew 30% YoY to Rs. 6,151 Cr 
• 
Revenue from Operations grew 28% YoY to Rs. 3,006 Cr  
• 
Gross Profit grew 31% YoY to Rs. 1,382 Cr 
• 
EBITDA grew 65% YoY to Rs. 263 Cr 
• 
EBITDA margins expanded to 8.7% in Q2 FY2027 vs 6.8% in Q2 FY2026 
• 
Profit Before Tax (PBT) was Rs. 149 Cr, up 168% YoY 
• 
Net Profit (PAT) was Rs. 101 Cr, up 207% YoY 
 
BUSINESS SUMMARY: 
Beauty saw strong momentum on the back of accelerated customer acquisition and premiumization of existing customers, 
and 330+ brands were launched in the past year. House of Nykaa continues to outperform supported by strong innovation, 
and Nykaa is excited about welcoming Simply Nam, a specialized, premium, professional grade colour cosmetics brand founded 
by celebrity makeup artist Namrata Soni to the portfolio. The fourth edition of Nykaaland once again brought together the 
beauty community in an immersive, experiential format with over 30,000 attendees. The Superstore business demonstrated 
how productivity can be improved to build the right foundation for future growth. Fashion also delivered a strong 
quarter, with the launch of Nykaa LUXE, a curated shop-in-shop bringing together homegrown and international luxury labels. 
Landmark launches, including the exclusive introduction of COS, further strengthened Nykaa’s premium fashion proposition.   
 
Speaking on this quarter’s results, Falguni Nayar, Executive Chairperson, Founder and CEO of Nykaa, said,  
“Our performance this quarter reflects the strength of the Nykaa ecosystem, with each of our businesses 
contributing to growth and productivity gains. We continued to improve operational efficiency, particularly 
across marketing and overheads. Beauty and Fashion are seeing accelerated growth, while House of Nykaa 
and Wellness offer significant runway for long-term growth. We remain focused on building differentiated 
businesses that serve our consumers and deliver sustainable growth over the long term.” 
 
BUSINESS HIGHLIGHTS: 
 
BEAUTY: 
 
• 
Nykaa’s Beauty vertical GMV for Q2 FY2027 stood at Rs. 4,454 Cr. This includes performance across 
businesses of e-commerce, retail stores, eB2B distribution and the House of Nykaa Beauty portfolio. NSV 

growth came in at 28% YoY this quarter with EBITDA up 51% YoY. 
 
Beauty Multi-brand Retail: 
 
• 
Nykaa’s brand launch engine remains robust as it accelerates bringing in globally trending brands to 
Indian consumers. This year, it launched over 330 brands across global, national & emerging beauty 
brands, further strengthening its portfolio, latest among which include Yves Rocher, Oribe, Mamonde, 
MEDIHEAL, &honey, and Purito Seoul, among others. These partnerships from multiple regions like 
France, Japan, Korea, USA as well as emerging Indian brands highlight Nykaa’s role in bringing globally 
bestselling and trending brands for the Indian consumer. 
 
• 
Nykaa’s fourth edition of Nykaaland, India’s largest immersive beauty festival, further brought together 
beauty enthusiasts, leading international and homegrown brands, celebrities and industry experts. 
Across all four editions, the festival has welcomed 100,000+ beauty enthusiasts, featured 50+ 
masterclasses led by renowned international and Indian beauty artists, and brought together 1,500+ 
celebrities, creators and KOLs, alongside 150+ international and homegrown brands.  
Nykaaland has evolved into a flagship IP that deepens consumer engagement, enables meaningful brand 
connections and strengthens Nykaa’s role in shaping India’s beauty community. 
 
• 
NYKAA NOW has expanded to 15 cities, with plans to reach 25+ cities by the end of FY2027, bringing 
delight, speed and convenience to beauty shoppers across India. Delivering India’s largest beauty, 
personal care and wellness assortment within 30-60 minutes, Nykaa Now offers over 1,000 marquee 
brands and more than 2X the BPC SKU depth of quick commerce. Its curated premium and luxe offerings 
are resonating with consumers, driving an AOV 3X that of the BPC category on quick commerce and a 
15% higher FOP compared to the Nykaa platform. 
 
• 
As India's largest beauty specialty retail network, the company expanded its beauty retail footprint to 
338 stores (+14 new stores in Q2) across 111 cities (+6 cities in Q2), with total retail space increasing 
+26% YoY to 3.4 lakh+ sq. ft. This is across multiple innovative retail formats, including 253 MBOs which 
are curated multi-brand destinations, 69 House of Nykaa owned brand outlets, and 16 exclusive brand 
experiential formats. Nykaa’s retail growth engine strengthens as scale, productivity and customer 
traction converge. 
 
HOUSE OF NYKAA (Beauty & Fashion): 
 
• 
House of Nykaa continued to scale rapidly during the quarter, achieving an annualized GMV run rate of 
Rs. 4,000 Cr+, and Rs. 2,300 Cr+ annualized NSV for Q2 FY2027, a 36% YoY NSV growth. The portfolio 
has served over 19 million customers to date, underscoring strong consumer affinity and sustained 
adoption. 
 
• 
House of Nykaa continued to build consumer relevance and unlock new growth opportunities via 
innovation across products, packaging and formulations. Dot & Key launched eight new shades of its 
Tinted Sunscreen in fun, fresh packaging, alongside the Dragon Fruit Jelly Bounce Moisturizer, offering 
lightweight hydration for oily and combination skin. Kay Beauty expanded into skincare this quarter, 
while marking its first anniversary in the UK through its presence across Space NK and TikTok Shop. 
Nykaa Cosmetics collaborated with Gen Z celebrity icon Sara Tendulkar and landed stellar lipstick 
launches, strengthening its position as a trend-led beauty brand. 

 
• 
The quarter also saw recognition of the immense consumer love received by Nykaa’s owned brands. 
Nykaa Cosmetics’ Matte to Last Lipstick won Best Lipstick Category at the Grazia Indie Awards, while 
Kay Beauty’s Lash Maximizer Mascara was recognised as Best Mascara at the same awards. Kay Beauty 
also received the Reader’s Choice award for its Soft Matte Full Coverage Concealer at the Vogue Beauty 
& Wellness Honours, and its Hydra Glow Tinted Sunscreen SPF 40 PA++ was named Best Base Product 
at the ELLE Beauty Awards. 
 
BEAUTY EB2B: SUPERSTORE BY NYKAA: 
 
• 
Superstore by Nykaa continued to scale, with GMV reaching Rs. 328 Cr, supported by an expanding 
retailer network and wider geographic reach. Its registered retailer base grew 27% YoY to over 550k+, 
making it one of India's fastest-growing beauty retail distribution platforms. This growth was achieved 
while keeping the number of business development executives (BDEs) constant over the past year, 
reflecting gains in productivity. During the quarter, Superstore further strengthened its portfolio across 
new-age skincare, makeup and wellness brands, with multiple brand launches across Recode, Lacto 
Calamine, Clay Co., BLA BLI BLU, Renee & Love Earth, among others 
 
• 
This quarter, Superstore also launched ‘Meri Dukan’, a personalised shopping experience designed to 
help retailers make more informed purchase decisions. Tailored to each retailer’s purchase history, 
geography and store type, it highlights products due for replenishment, identifies demand in local 
markets, surfaces daily deals and price drops, and recommends relevant products and brands. 
 
FASHION: 
 
• 
Fashion sustained strong growth alongside meaningful profitability improvement, with NSV increasing 
47% YoY to Rs. 509 Cr. EBITDA margin (as a percentage of NSV) expanded from -3.5% in Q2 FY2026 to 
0.2% in Q2 FY2027, underscoring the strength of the business model.  
 
• 
Nykaa Fashion strengthened its premium and luxury fashion proposition with the launch of Nykaa 
Fashion LUXE, a dedicated shop-in-shop destination bringing together international luxury brands and 
leading Indian designer labels across fashion, accessories, jewellery, watches and home. The platform 
further elevates luxury discovery through curated edits, personalized concierge services, styling and 
customizations – all while sourcing directly from brand partners and authorized distributors. 
This quarter also, Nykaa Fashion delivered over 250+ brand launches, including the exclusive launch of 
COS, and among others. 
 
OTHER UPDATES: 
 

• 
Nykaa acquired a 82% majority stake in Simply Nam, India’s pioneering celebrity makeup artist brand. 
Founded in 2020 by celebrated makeup artist Namrata Soni and Bozzil, a venture studio founded and 
led by Hanna Strömgren Khan, the brand combines Namrata’s professional makeup expertise with 
clinically tested, expert-backed formulations shaped by consumer needs. 
The acquisition adds a complementary dimension to House of Nykaa’s makeup portfolio, which caters 
to diverse consumers, from trend-led makeup for younger audiences to celebrity-led beauty brands 
with inclusivity at its core. Among these - Simply Nam allows Nykaa to play in the specialized, premium, 
professional grade makeup segment. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approvals and closing 
conditions.  
 
• 
Nykaa strengthened its strategic partnership with L’Oréal through a collaboration with BOLD, L’Oréal’s 
corporate venture capital fund, to jointly invest in high-growth Indian beauty and personal care brands. 
The partnership combines Nykaa’s consumer ecosystem, retail network and distribution capabilities 
with L’Oréal’s global beauty expertise, mentorship and strategic guidance to support emerging brands 
in scaling their businesses, while enabling founders to retain operational and creative control. 
 
------- END ------- 
ABOUT NYKAA: 
Nykaa’s vision is to bring inspiration and joy to people everywhere, every day. Born from a desire to make beauty 
a mainstream choice, the Nykaa journey began in 2012 as a digital-first, consumer-tech beauty company. Falguni 
Nayar’s entrepreneurial leap with Nykaa tapped into an underserved beauty retail market, disrupting the 
ecosystem and putting India in the global spotlight. Today, Nykaa has expanded its offerings to include fashion 
and B2B, launching platforms such as Nykaa Fashion, Nykaa Man, and Nykaa Superstore. Nykaa has also expanded 
into the Middle East through its omnichannel beauty offering ‘Nysaa’.  
Over the years, Nykaa has steadily captured the hearts of consumers, serving over 65 million customers (as of 30 
September 2026) through its online platforms and 338 offline beauty destinations (as of 30 September 2026), 
while building loyal communities through engaging and educative content.  
House of Nykaa - Nykaa continues to build its house of brands with a sharp focus on innovation and consumer 
delight. Nykaa Cosmetics, Dot & Key, Kay Beauty, Nykaa Collections, Nykaa Wanderlust, Nykaa Perfumes, Earth 
Rhythm and Aminu alongside celebrated fashion labels such as Nykd by Nykaa, KICA, 20 Dresses, RSVP, and Gajra 
Gang, have become household names, consistently delivering inspiration and high-performing products to 
consumers.  
Nykaa’s unwavering commitment to authenticity and customer-centricity has cemented its position as the retailer 
of choice for international brands looking to enter the Indian market. With Nykaa’s Global Store, a gateway to 
some of the world’s most coveted brands, the company harnesses its powerful supply chain and marketing 
expertise to create a flawless shopping experience. Trusted by renowned global names like Rare Beauty, K18, 
JudyDoll, Chanel Fragrance and Beauty, SK-II, Nike, H&M, Charlotte Tilbury, Elf Cosmetics, Urban Decay, 
Birkenstock, Foot Locker, Revolve, and Cider, Nykaa has empowered these iconic brands to connect with Indian 
consumers and make a lasting impact in the market.  
Nykaa has been recognized with prestigious accolades, including a place in the TIME100 Most Influential 
Companies List and the Isidoro Alvarez Lifetime Achievement Medal at the World Retail Congress in Barcelona. 
Falguni Nayar, Founder and CEO, has also won personal honours such as EY Entrepreneur of the Year and Power 
Businesswoman by Forbes Asia.

FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited 
Quarter ended September 30, 2026 – Media Press Release 
 
Nykaa delivers strong Q2 FY2027 performance; consolidated Net revenue up 28% YoY, PAT up 207% YoY 
 
FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited (referred to as “Nykaa” or the “Company”), today announced its financial results for the 
quarter ended September 30, 2026 
 
Q2 FY2027 FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS SUMMARY: 
 
• 
Consolidated GMV grew 30% YoY to Rs. 6,151 Cr 
• 
Revenue from Operations grew 28% YoY to Rs. 3,006 Cr  
• 
Gross Profit grew 31% YoY to Rs. 1,382 Cr 
• 
EBITDA grew 65% YoY to Rs. 263 Cr 
• 
EBITDA margins expanded to 8.7% in Q2 FY2027 vs 6.8% in Q2 FY2026 
• 
Profit Before Tax (PBT) was Rs. 149 Cr, up 168% YoY 
• 
Net Profit (PAT) was Rs. 101 Cr, up 207% YoY 
 
BUSINESS SUMMARY: 
Beauty saw strong momentum on the back of accelerated customer acquisition and premiumization of existing customers, 
and 330+ brands were launched in the past year. House of Nykaa continues to outperform supported by strong innovation, 
and Nykaa is excited about welcoming Simply Nam, a specialized, premium, professional grade colour cosmetics brand founded 
by celebrity makeup artist Namrata Soni to the portfolio. The fourth edition of Nykaaland once again brought together the 
beauty community in an immersive, experiential format with over 30,000 attendees. The Superstore business demonstrated 
how productivity can be improved to build the right foundation for future growth. Fashion also delivered a strong 
quarter, with the launch of Nykaa LUXE, a curated shop-in-shop bringing together homegrown and international luxury labels. 
Landmark launches, including the exclusive introduction of COS, further strengthened Nykaa’s premium fashion proposition.   
 
Speaking on this quarter’s results, Falguni Nayar, Executive Chairperson, Founder and CEO of Nykaa, said,  
“Our performance this quarter reflects the strength of the Nykaa ecosystem, with each of our businesses 
contributing to growth and productivity gains. We continued to improve operational efficiency, particularly 
across marketing and overheads. Beauty and Fashion are seeing accelerated growth, while House of Nykaa 
and Wellness offer significant runway for long-term growth. We remain focused on building differentiated 
businesses that serve our consumers and deliver sustainable growth over the long term.” 
 
BUSINESS HIGHLIGHTS: 
 
BEAUTY: 
 
• 
Nykaa’s Beauty vertical GMV for Q2 FY2027 stood at Rs. 4,454 Cr. This includes performance across 
businesses of e-commerce, retail stores, eB2B distribution and the House of Nykaa Beauty portfolio. NSV 

growth came in at 28% YoY this quarter with EBITDA up 51% YoY. 
 
Beauty Multi-brand Retail: 
 
• 
Nykaa’s brand launch engine remains robust as it accelerates bringing in globally trending brands to 
Indian consumers. This year, it launched over 330 brands across global, national & emerging beauty 
brands, further strengthening its portfolio, latest among which include Yves Rocher, Oribe, Mamonde, 
MEDIHEAL, &honey, and Purito Seoul, among others. These partnerships from multiple regions like 
France, Japan, Korea, USA as well as emerging Indian brands highlight Nykaa’s role in bringing globally 
bestselling and trending brands for the Indian consumer. 
 
• 
Nykaa’s fourth edition of Nykaaland, India’s largest immersive beauty festival, further brought together 
beauty enthusiasts, leading international and homegrown brands, celebrities and industry experts. 
Across all four editions, the festival has welcomed 100,000+ beauty enthusiasts, featured 50+ 
masterclasses led by renowned international and Indian beauty artists, and brought together 1,500+ 
celebrities, creators and KOLs, alongside 150+ international and homegrown brands.  
Nykaaland has evolved into a flagship IP that deepens consumer engagement, enables meaningful brand 
connections and strengthens Nykaa’s role in shaping India’s beauty community. 
 
• 
NYKAA NOW has expanded to 15 cities, with plans to reach 25+ cities by the end of FY2027, bringing 
delight, speed and convenience to beauty shoppers across India. Delivering India’s largest beauty, 
personal care and wellness assortment within 30-60 minutes, Nykaa Now offers over 1,000 marquee 
brands and more than 2X the BPC SKU depth of quick commerce. Its curated premium and luxe offerings 
are resonating with consumers, driving an AOV 3X that of the BPC category on quick commerce and a 
15% higher FOP compared to the Nykaa platform. 
 
• 
As India's largest beauty specialty retail network, the company expanded its beauty retail footprint to 
338 stores (+14 new stores in Q2) across 111 cities (+6 cities in Q2), with total retail space increasing 
+26% YoY to 3.4 lakh+ sq. ft. This is across multiple innovative retail formats, including 253 MBOs which 
are curated multi-brand destinations, 69 House of Nykaa owned brand outlets, and 16 exclusive brand 
experiential formats. Nykaa’s retail growth engine strengthens as scale, productivity and customer 
traction converge. 
 
HOUSE OF NYKAA (Beauty & Fashion): 
 
• 
House of Nykaa continued to scale rapidly during the quarter, achieving an annualized GMV run rate of 
Rs. 4,000 Cr+, and Rs. 2,300 Cr+ annualized NSV for Q2 FY2027, a 36% YoY NSV growth. The portfolio 
has served over 19 million customers to date, underscoring strong consumer affinity and sustained 
adoption. 
 
• 
House of Nykaa continued to build consumer relevance and unlock new growth opportunities via 
innovation across products, packaging and formulations. Dot & Key launched eight new shades of its 
Tinted Sunscreen in fun, fresh packaging, alongside the Dragon Fruit Jelly Bounce Moisturizer, offering 
lightweight hydration for oily and combination skin. Kay Beauty expanded into skincare this quarter, 
while marking its first anniversary in the UK through its presence across Space NK and TikTok Shop. 
Nykaa Cosmetics collaborated with Gen Z celebrity icon Sara Tendulkar and landed stellar lipstick 
launches, strengthening its position as a trend-led beauty brand. 

 
• 
The quarter also saw recognition of the immense consumer love received by Nykaa’s owned brands. 
Nykaa Cosmetics’ Matte to Last Lipstick won Best Lipstick Category at the Grazia Indie Awards, while 
Kay Beauty’s Lash Maximizer Mascara was recognised as Best Mascara at the same awards. Kay Beauty 
also received the Reader’s Choice award for its Soft Matte Full Coverage Concealer at the Vogue Beauty 
& Wellness Honours, and its Hydra Glow Tinted Sunscreen SPF 40 PA++ was named Best Base Product 
at the ELLE Beauty Awards. 
 
BEAUTY EB2B: SUPERSTORE BY NYKAA: 
 
• 
Superstore by Nykaa continued to scale, with GMV reaching Rs. 328 Cr, supported by an expanding 
retailer network and wider geographic reach. Its registered retailer base grew 27% YoY to over 550k+, 
making it one of India's fastest-growing beauty retail distribution platforms. This growth was achieved 
while keeping the number of business development executives (BDEs) constant over the past year, 
reflecting gains in productivity. During the quarter, Superstore further strengthened its portfolio across 
new-age skincare, makeup and wellness brands, with multiple brand launches across Recode, Lacto 
Calamine, Clay Co., BLA BLI BLU, Renee & Love Earth, among others 
 
• 
This quarter, Superstore also launched ‘Meri Dukan’, a personalised shopping experience designed to 
help retailers make more informed purchase decisions. Tailored to each retailer’s purchase history, 
geography and store type, it highlights products due for replenishment, identifies demand in local 
markets, surfaces daily deals and price drops, and recommends relevant products and brands. 
 
FASHION: 
 
• 
Fashion sustained strong growth alongside meaningful profitability improvement, with NSV increasing 
47% YoY to Rs. 509 Cr. EBITDA margin (as a percentage of NSV) expanded from -3.5% in Q2 FY2026 to 
0.2% in Q2 FY2027, underscoring the strength of the business model.  
 
• 
Nykaa Fashion strengthened its premium and luxury fashion proposition with the launch of Nykaa 
Fashion LUXE, a dedicated shop-in-shop destination bringing together international luxury brands and 
leading Indian designer labels across fashion, accessories, jewellery, watches and home. The platform 
further elevates luxury discovery through curated edits, personalized concierge services, styling and 
customizations – all while sourcing directly from brand partners and authorized distributors. 
This quarter also, Nykaa Fashion delivered over 250+ brand launches, including the exclusive launch of 
COS, and among others. 
 
OTHER UPDATES: 
 

• 
Nykaa acquired a 82% majority stake in Simply Nam, India’s pioneering celebrity makeup artist brand. 
Founded in 2020 by celebrated makeup artist Namrata Soni and Bozzil, a venture studio founded and 
led by Hanna Strömgren Khan, the brand combines Namrata’s professional makeup expertise with 
clinically tested, expert-backed formulations shaped by consumer needs. 
The acquisition adds a complementary dimension to House of Nykaa’s makeup portfolio, which caters 
to diverse consumers, from trend-led makeup for younger audiences to celebrity-led beauty brands 
with inclusivity at its core. Among these - Simply Nam allows Nykaa to play in the specialized, premium, 
professional grade makeup segment. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approvals and closing 
conditions.  
 
• 
Nykaa strengthened its strategic partnership with L’Oréal through a collaboration with BOLD, L’Oréal’s 
corporate venture capital fund, to jointly invest in high-growth Indian beauty and personal care brands. 
The partnership combines Nykaa’s consumer ecosystem, retail network and distribution capabilities 
with L’Oréal’s global beauty expertise, mentorship and strategic guidance to support emerging brands 
in scaling their businesses, while enabling founders to retain operational and creative control. 
 
------- END ------- 
ABOUT NYKAA: 
Nykaa’s vision is to bring inspiration and joy to people everywhere, every day. Born from a desire to make beauty 
a mainstream choice, the Nykaa journey began in 2012 as a digital-first, consumer-tech beauty company. Falguni 
Nayar’s entrepreneurial leap with Nykaa tapped into an underserved beauty retail market, disrupting the 
ecosystem and putting India in the global spotlight. Today, Nykaa has expanded its offerings to include fashion 
and B2B, launching platforms such as Nykaa Fashion, Nykaa Man, and Nykaa Superstore. Nykaa has also expanded 
into the Middle East through its omnichannel beauty offering ‘Nysaa’.  
Over the years, Nykaa has steadily captured the hearts of consumers, serving over 65 million customers (as of 30

while building loyal communities through engaging and educative content.  
House of Nykaa - Nykaa continues to build its house of brands with a sharp focus on innovation and consumer 
delight. Nykaa Cosmetics, Dot & Key, Kay Beauty, Nykaa Collections, Nykaa Wanderlust, Nykaa Perfumes, Earth 
Rhythm and Aminu alongside celebrated fashion labels such as Nykd by Nykaa, KICA, 20 Dresses, RSVP, and Gajra 
Gang, have become household names, consistently delivering inspiration and high-performing products to 
consumers.  
Nykaa’s unwavering commitment to authenticity and customer-centricity has cemented its position as the retailer 
of choice for international brands looking to enter the Indian market. With Nykaa’s Global Store, a gateway to 
some of the world’s most coveted brands, the company harnesses its powerful supply chain and marketing 
expertise to create a flawless shopping experience. Trusted by renowned global names like Rare Beauty, K18, 
JudyDoll, Chanel Fragrance and Beauty, SK-II, Nike, H&M, Charlotte Tilbury, Elf Cosmetics, Urban Decay, 
Birkenstock, Foot Locker, Revolve, and Cider, Nykaa has empowered these iconic brands to connect with Indian 
consumers and make a lasting impact in the market.

Businesswoman by Forbes Asia.

Glossary
Term
Description
Annual Unique Transacting Customers (AUTC)
Unique customers identified by their email-id or mobile number who have placed at least one Order on our websites, mobile applications or physical stores during the last 12 months ended as on measurement date. Annual Transacting 
Customers, with respect to beauty and personal care, denotes Annual Transacting customers on the Nykaa websites and mobile applications and physical stores. Annual Transacting customers, with respect to Fashion, denotes Annual 
Transacting customers on the Nykaa Fashion website and the mobile application, with respect to Others, denotes Annual Transacting customers on the Nykaa Man website and the mobile application, “Superstore by Nykaa” website and 
mobile application
Average Order Value (AOV)
GMV generated across our websites, mobile applications and physical stores divided by Orders considered for such GMV.
Contribution Profit
Contribution Profit is a non-GAAP financial measure. Contribution Profit refers to Gross profit for the period, after the adjustment of Fulfillment Expenses, Marketing Expenses (Other than branding), Selling & Distribution Expenses.
Cost of Goods Sold
Cost of Goods Sold is a non-GAAP financial measure. cost of goods sold refers to cost of material consumed, purchase of traded goods, changes in finished goods and stock-in-trade.
EBITDA
EBITDA is a non-GAAP financial measure. EBITDA refers to our profit/(loss) before Tax for the period, as adjusted to exclude (i) Other Income, (ii) Depreciation and Amortization Expenses, (iii) Finance Costs. EBITDA Margin refers to 
the percentage margin derived by dividing EBITDA by Revenue from Operations
Gross Profit
Gross Profit is a non-GAAP financial measure. Gross Profit refers to Revenue from Operations less COGS. Gross Profit Margin refers to the percentage margin derived by dividing Gross Profit by Revenue from Operations.
Gross Merchandise Value (GMV)
Monetary value of Orders inclusive of taxes and gross of discounts, if any, across our websites, mobile applications and physical stores prior to product returns or order cancellations and including sales to and through third party channels. GMV, 
with respect to BPC, denotes GMV of BPC vertical. GMV, with respect to Fashion, denotes GMV of Fashion vertical. GMV, with respect to Others, denotes GMV of Other Verticals
Monthly Average Unique Visitors (MAUV)
Number of unique devices (laptops, mobile phones, etc.) which recorded at least one Visit to our websites or mobile applications during the month. Monthly Average Unique Visitors, with respect to BPC, denotes Monthly Average Unique 
Visitors on the Nykaa websites and mobile applications. Monthly Average Unique Visitors, with respect to Fashion, denotes Monthly Average Unique Visitors on the Nykaa Fashion website and the mobile application. Monthly Average 
Unique Visitors, with respect to Others, denotes Monthly Average Unique Visitors on the Nykaa Man website and the mobile application, “Superstore by Nykaa” website and mobile application
Revenue from operations
Revenue from operations includes sale of products, marketing support revenue, income from marketplace and logistics services
Net Sales Value (NSV)
NSV refer to Net Sales Value and calculated basis GMV minus Discounts, Cancellation & Returns, and Taxes.
Orders
All orders placed on our websites, mobile applications and physical stores prior to any cancellations and returns. Orders, with respect to BPC Vertical, includes all Orders that placed on Nykaa websites & mobile applications and Physical 
Store, having at least one BPC product. Orders, with respect to Fashion Vertical, includes all Orders that placed on Nykaa website & mobile application, and Fashion.com website & mobile application having at least one fashion product . 
Orders, with respect to Others includes all Orders that placed on Nykaa Man website & application, and “Superstore by
Nykaa” website & mobile application.
Visits
Number of visits to our websites and mobile applications. A visit is considered ended when no new request has been recorded in more than 30 minutes from the same device to the website or the mobile application. Visits, with respect to 
beauty and personal care, denotes Visits to the Nykaa websites and mobile applications. Visits, with respect to Fashion, denotes Visits to the Nykaa Fashion website and the mobile application. Visits with respect to Others, denotes Visits 
to Nykaa Man website and mobile application, “Superstore by Nykaa” website and mobile application
Existing Customers
Existing Customers, identified by their email-id or mobile number, are Customers who placed at least one Order in any prior Financial Year on our websites or mobile applications.
New Customers
New Customers, identified by their email-id or mobile number, are Customers who placed at least one Order in any current Financial Year on our websites or mobile applications.
Verticals
Beauty includes BPC online, BPC physical Stores, Beauty owned brands, Superstore by Nykaa and Nykaa Man Grooming,
Fashion includes Nykaa Fashion, LBB, and Nykaa Man Lifestyle

GMV generated across our websites, mobile applications and physical stores divided by Orders considered for such GMV.
Contribution Profit
Contribution Profit is a non-GAAP financial measure. Contribution Profit refers to Gross profit for the period, after the adjustment of Fulfillment Expenses, Marketing Expenses (Other than branding), Selling & Distribution Expenses.
Cost of Goods Sold
Cost of Goods Sold is a non-GAAP financial measure. cost of goods sold refers to cost of material consumed, purchase of traded goods, changes in finished goods and stock-in-trade.
EBITDA
EBITDA is a non-GAAP financial measure. EBITDA refers to our profit/(loss) before Tax for the period, as adjusted to exclude (i) Other Income, (ii) Depreciation and Amortization Expenses, (iii) Finance Costs. EBITDA Margin refers to 
the percentage margin derived by dividing EBITDA by Revenue from Operations
Gross Profit
Gross Profit is a non-GAAP financial measure. Gross Profit refers to Revenue from Operations less COGS. Gross Profit Margin refers to the percentage margin derived by dividing Gross Profit by Revenue from Operations.
Gross Merchandise Value (GMV)
Monetary value of Orders inclusive of taxes and gross of discounts, if any, across our websites, mobile applications and physical stores prior to product returns or order cancellations and including sales to and through third party channels. GMV, 
with respect to BPC, denotes GMV of BPC vertical. GMV, with respect to Fashion, denotes GMV of Fashion vertical. GMV, with respect to Others, denotes GMV of Other Verticals
Monthly Average Unique Visitors (MAUV)
Number of unique devices (laptops, mobile phones, etc.) which recorded at least one Visit to our websites or mobile applications during the month. Monthly Average Unique Visitors, with respect to BPC, denotes Monthly Average Unique 
Visitors on the Nykaa websites and mobile applications. Monthly Average Unique Visitors, with respect to Fashion, denotes Monthly Average Unique Visitors on the Nykaa Fashion website and the mobile application. Monthly Average 
Unique Visitors, with respect to Others, denotes Monthly Average Unique Visitors on the Nykaa Man website and the mobile application, “Superstore by Nykaa” website and mobile application
Revenue from operations
Revenue from operations includes sale of products, marketing support revenue, income from marketplace and logistics services
Net Sales Value (NSV)
NSV refer to Net Sales Value and calculated basis GMV minus Discounts, Cancellation & Returns, and Taxes.
Orders
All orders placed on our websites, mobile applications and physical stores prior to any cancellations and returns. Orders, with respect to BPC Vertical, includes all Orders that placed on Nykaa websites & mobile applications and Physical 
Store, having at least one BPC product. Orders, with respect to Fashion Vertical, includes all Orders that placed on Nykaa website & mobile application, and Fashion.com website & mobile application having at least one fashion product . 
Orders, with respect to Others includes all Orders that placed on Nykaa Man website & application, and “Superstore by
Nykaa” website & mobile application.
Visits
Number of visits to our websites and mobile applications. A visit is considered ended when no new request has been recorded in more than 30 minutes from the same device to the website or the mobile application. Visits, with respect to 
beauty and personal care, denotes Visits to the Nykaa websites and mobile applications. Visits, with respect to Fashion, denotes Visits to the Nykaa Fashion website and the mobile application. Visits with respect to Others, denotes Visits 
to Nykaa Man website and mobile application, “Superstore by Nykaa” website and mobile application
Existing Customers
Existing Customers, identified by their email-id or mobile number, are Customers who placed at least one Order in any prior Financial Year on our websites or mobile applications.
New Customers
New Customers, identified by their email-id or mobile number, are Customers who placed at least one Order in any current Financial Year on our websites or mobile applications.
Verticals
Beauty includes BPC online, BPC physical Stores, Beauty owned brands, Superstore by Nykaa and Nykaa Man Grooming,
Fashion includes Nykaa Fashion, LBB, and Nykaa Man Lifestyle

shares in Earth Rhythm Limited (ERL) for consideration oft 9.43 crores during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

the agreed schedule under the Share Subscription cum Purchase Agreement. The Holding Company is in the process of completing the Purchase Price 
Allocation (PPA) in accordance with Ind AS 103, 'Business Combinations'. Accordingly, as at the acquisition date, it has recognised the Group's share in the 
carrying amount of assets and liabilities of the subsidiary and non-controlling interest (NCI). The difference between the Purchase consideration and net 
assets (including NCI) amounting tot 26.02 crores is recognised as goodwill on a provisional basis.

PRESS RELEASE 
Unaudited standalone & consolidated financial results for the half year ended 
September 30, 2026 
 
Sundaram Finance disbursements grew by 25% to Rs. 19,302 crores in H1FY27; 
Q2FY27 grew by 28% to Rs. 10,355 crores  
AUM grows 19% to Rs. 65,992 crores  
Profit after tax closed at Rs. 997 crores, up by 21% over H1FY26 
Gross Stage 3 assets stood at 1.84% (2.03% as of Sep 30, 2025) and Net Stage 3 assets at 0.91% 
(1.13% as of Sep 30, 2025) 
ROA at 2.86% for H1FY27 (2.72% for H1FY26) 
Capital Adequacy Ratio at 18.5% (19.3% for H1FY26) 
The Board of Directors of Sundaram Finance Ltd. (SFL) approved the unaudited standalone and 
consolidated financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, at its meeting held on 
November 4, 2026, in Chennai.  
“Domestic economic momentum remained strong in Q2FY27 despite an increasingly challenging 
global environment. Renewed tensions in West Asia, crude oil price volatility and tighter global 
financial conditions increased inflationary and external-sector risks. Against this backdrop, Team 
Sundaram delivered 19% AUM growth to Rs. 65,992 crores, asset quality with net stage 3 assets at 
0.91% against 1.13% last year, and 21% year-on-year growth in profit after tax. Our Group 
companies in asset management, general insurance and home finance continued to report strong 
results. We remain committed to our time-tested approach of steady, sustainable growth, best-in-
class asset quality and consistent profitability,” said Harsha Viji, Executive Vice Chairman. 
AUM for H1FY27 grew 19% to Rs. 65,992 crores. Disbursements for H1FY27 recorded a growth of 
25% over H1FY26 and for Q2FY27, disbursements grew 28% Y-o-Y. Gross stage 3 assets as on 
September 30, 2026, stood at 1.84% with provision cover of 51% as against 2.03% as on 
September 30, 2025, with provision cover of 45%. Profits from operations performed strongly, 
growing by 23% in H1FY27 and 11% in Q2FY27. Profit after tax registered a 21% rise in H1FY27, 
with net profit at Rs. 997 crores and for Q2, PAT grew 21% to Rs. 475 crores. Return on assets 
closed at 2.86% in H1FY27 as against 2.72% for H1FY26 and capital adequacy at 18.5% remained 
quite comfortable. 
 
P N 
SRIKANT
Digitally signed by 
P N SRIKANT 
Date: 2026.11.04 
14:45:48 +05'30'

 
 
 
 
Rajiv Lochan, Managing Director stated, “Our outlook for H2 is constructive on growth coupled 
with a need for monitoring external factors around geopolitical tensions, monetary policy direction 
and the impact to sentiment of the below normal monsoon. We have entered H2 with strong 
momentum and a superior asset-quality position than last year. As the rate cycle turns, our focus is 
to sustain growth, improve asset quality further and build resilience in profitability through 
disciplined pricing, optimal asset mix and early intervention on collections. As always, we will take 
a long-term, through-cycle view in delivering the Sundaram experience to our customers, partners 
and employees.” 
 
STANDALONE PERFORMANCE HIGHLIGHTS FOR H1FY27  
 Disbursements for H1FY27 grew by 25% to Rs. 19,302 crores as compared to Rs. 15,423 
crores registered in H1FY26. Disbursements for Q2FY27 grew by 28% to Rs. 10,355 crores 
as compared to Rs. 8,113 crores registered in Q2FY26. Disbursements for H1FY27 includes 
acquisition of loans amounting to Rs. 726 crores from Sundaram Home Finance Limited.  
 The assets under management grew by 19% to Rs. 65,992 crores as on 30th September 
2026 as against Rs. 55,419 crores as on 30th September 2025. 
 Net interest income (NII) grew by 18% to Rs. 1,888 crores in H1FY27 from Rs. 1,603 crores 
in H1FY26. Q2FY27 growth in NII was 17% to Rs. 963 crores. 
 Gross stage 3 assets as on 30th September 2026 stood at 1.84% with 51% provision cover as 
against 2.03% with provision cover of 45% as on 30th September 2025. Net stage 3 assets as

Chairperson’s Opening Remarks

Biocon at an Inflection Point: From Investment to Value Creation
▪
Well positioned for structural industry shifts, supported by Biocon’s global Biosimilars platform and Syngene’s 
integrated research, development and manufacturing capabilities
▪
Transitioning from investment-led capability building to commercial acceleration, with increasing focus on operating 
leverage, cash generation and shareholder value
▪
H1 FY27 execution milestones strengthen the foundation for a stronger H2, including additional insulin capacity and 
continued regulatory and commercial progress
▪
Pertuzumab demonstrates our ability to navigate both regulatory and IP pathways, with the positive CHMP opinion 
and Genentech settlement providing greater visibility on commercialization across key markets

Expanding Market Presence across Key Geographies
▪
North America
❖
Established products continued to demonstrate resilience, with Ogivri® and Fulphila® maintaining leadership positions
❖
Yesintek® sustained its positive momentum, supported by market-share gains and improving access
❖
Yesafili recorded an encouraging US launch, supported by new contracts and important payor wins
▪
Europe
❖
Portfolio expansion continued with launches of ustekinumab, denosumab and aflibercept across several markets
❖
Approximately 20 tender awards across Italy, Spain, France and Denmark strengthen broader market access
❖
Positive CHMP opinion for Pertuzumab and regulatory progress for insulin glargine support the future growth pipeline
▪
Emerging Markets
❖
Thirteen new launches across APAC, Latin America and AFMET-CIS broadened the commercial footprint
❖
The 10-year Pertuzumab partnership in Brazil provides long-term revenue visibility in an important biologics market
❖
The partnership with Biomm supports the semaglutide strategy in Brazil, extending the GLP-1 opportunity into EMs

Dear Sir/Madam, 
Subject: Outcome of the Board Meeting 
Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (‘SEBI Listing Regulations’), we wish to inform you that the 
Board of Directors at its meeting held today, i.e. Wednesday, November 04, 2026, inter alia, has: 
 
(i) Financial results: 
 
Approved the unaudited financial results (standalone and consolidated) of the Company prepared as per 
Indian Accounting Standards (Ind-AS) for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
A copy of the aforesaid unaudited financial results along with the limited review report of the 
statutory auditors is enclosed herewith. 
 
(ii) Changes in Senior Management Personnel: 
 
(a) Noted the resignation of Dr. Mandar Shrikant Ghatnekar as the Chief Technology Officer (Senior 
Management Personnel) of the Company w.e.f. close of business hours of December 31, 2026. A 
copy of his letter of resignation is enclosed herewith. 
 
(b) Based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, approved the 
appointment of Mr. Mukesh Rathi as the Chief Technology Officer (Senior Management Personnel) 
of the Company w.e.f. January 01, 2027. 
 
The details as required under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations read with SEBI Master Circular no. 
HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, with reference to the aforesaid changes 
are given as “Annexure I”. 

 
    
 
The above information will also be available on the website of the Company at www.biocon.com. 
 
Further, the Board Meeting commenced at 11:20 A.M. and concluded at 01:10 P.M.  
 
Kindly take the above information on record and acknowledge. 
 
Thanking You. 
Yours faithfully,  
For Biocon Limited 
 
 
 
Rajesh U. Shanoy 
Company Secretary and Compliance officer

ANNEXURE A 
 
BRIEF PROFILE - MUKESH RATHI 
 
Mukesh Rathi brings over 27 years of leadership experience across digital 
transformation, AI-led innovation, process excellence, and technology 
management. 
 
Prior to joining us, he served as Group Chief Digital Officer at Hinduja Group, 
where he spearheaded the Group’s enterprise-wide digital and AI strategy. Before 
that, he spent over a decade at Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories in senior leadership roles, 
including Global Chief Digital and Information Officer, driving enterprise-wide 
transformation, strengthening process excellence, and leveraging technology to 
accelerate business performance and innovation. 
 
Earlier in his career, Mukesh held leadership and consulting roles at Hewlett Packard, SAP, and Unilever, 
building a strong foundation in technology, business transformation, and operational excellence.

Subject: Stepping down as Chief Technology Officer 
Dear Sir/Madam. 
This is to inform that I hereby tender my resignation as the Chief Technology Officer of 
Biocon limited effective from the dose of business hours on December 31, 2026 to 
take up opportunities outside the organisation. 
I express my sincere gratitude to the Board for the opportunity, trust and support 
extended to me during my tenure. 
I hereby consent to use this letter for the purpose of making disclosures. under SEBI 
{Listing Obligations and Disciosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and relevant 
filings with the appropriate authorities/regulators as may be required. 
Thanking You, 
Ma dar Shrikant Ghatnekar

Mukesh Rathi brings over 27 years of leadership experience across digital 
transformation, AI-led innovation, process excellence, and technology 
management.

transformation, strengthening process excellence, and leveraging technology to 
accelerate business performance and innovation.

PRESS RELEASE  
 
Biocon Q2FY27 Total Income at Rs 4,423 Cr; 
EBITDA at Rs 865 Cr; Net Profit at Rs 41 Cr; Biopharma Revenue Up 5% 
 
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India: November 4, 2026: 
 
Biocon Limited (BSE code: 532523, NSE: BIOCON), an innovation-led global biopharmaceuticals 
company, today announced its consolidated financial results for the fiscal second quarter ended 
September 30, 2026. 
FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE 
• 
Consolidated operating revenue increased 
2% YoY to Rs 4,389 crore. 
• 
Biopharma revenue increased 5% YoY to Rs 
3,583 crore. 
o Biosimilars revenue increased 3% YoY to 
Rs 2,809 crore. 
o Generics revenue increased 10% YoY Rs 
774 crore. 
• 
Services revenue increased 13% QoQ to Rs 
833 crore. 
 
Note: Revenue contribution as a % of Revenue 
from Operations  
• 
Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs 865 crore.  
• 
Interest cost continued to trend lower during the quarter, declining 12% YoY to Rs 240 crore, 
following the actions taken to strengthen the balance sheet.  
• 
Net Profit before exceptional items was Rs 44 crore. 
• 
Secured a landmark 10-year biosimilar Pertuzumab PDP partnership in Brazil valued at ~USD 400 
million. 
 
LEADERSHIP COMMENTS 
“Biocon continued to achieve industry firsts in biosimilars, with our Pertuzumab becoming the first 
monoclonal antibody biosimilar recommended under the EMA’s new tailored clinical development 
pathway. This represents an important milestone for biosimilar innovation and patient access. The 
operationalization of our second Insulin Glargine fill-finish line in Malaysia, with commercial supplies 
already underway, further reaffirms our global manufacturing excellence. Together with our continued 
investments in technology and innovation, these milestones reflect the progress of our strategic 
transformation and reinforce our confidence in Biocon’s long-term growth trajectory.” 
 – Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, Executive Chairperson, Biocon Limited 
 
“This quarter we continued to make significant progress on our strategic priorities, laying the foundation 
for a stronger second half of FY27. Our global settlement with Genentech for Pebrilzo® (biosimilar 
Pertuzumab) secured the earliest licensed launch dates across Europe, UK, the U.S. and emerging 
markets providing greater visibility to a significant future growth driver. We also secured a landmark 10-
year Pertuzumab PDP partnership in Brazil valued at ~USD 400 million, underscoring our ability to win 
and execute large-scale biologics deals. 
Together with the upcoming European launch of Pertuzumab, expanded insulin manufacturing capacity 
in Malaysia to support growing U.S. demand, and the strong early momentum of Yesafili™ and Yesintek® 
in the U.S., we are well positioned for growth in the second half of FY27.” 
– Shreehas Tambe, CEO & Managing Director, Biocon Limited  

 
 
                              
2 
 
 
“Syngene delivered 13% sequential revenue growth in Q2, supported by positive traction in our CDMO 
business, with operating EBITDA margin improving by 6 percentage points. Year-on-year revenue 
declined 9%, while operating EBITDA margin stood at 18%, in line with expectations, primarily reflecting 
lower Zoetis revenues and forex hedge losses.  
A key milestone in the quarter was the signing of our first manufacturing agreement for the Bayview 
biologics facility in the U.S. Our focus remains on improving our integrated drug discovery offering, 
commercial execution, asset utilization and cost competitiveness to drive sustainable growth.”   
– Siddharth Mittal, CEO & Managing Director, Syngene International Limited

About Biocon Limited  
Biocon Limited (BSE: 532523, NSE: BIOCON) is a global biopharmaceutical company driven by its purpose to 
provide affordable, life-changing medicines to patients worldwide. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Biocon 
addresses some of the world’s most pressing healthcare challenges across chronic and non-communicable 
diseases by offering both biosimilars and generics at scale across geographies. Through this diversified portfolio, 
Biocon focuses on areas of high unmet need, spanning key therapy areas including diabetes, oncology, obesity, 
cardiovascular diseases, immunology, ophthalmology, and bone health. The company has pioneered several 
industry firsts that have helped shape the global biosimilars landscape. To date, the company has commercialized 
12 biosimilar products and 30+ generic formulations globally. It has robust research and development pipeline of 
20 biosimilar assets, as well as GLP-1 peptides and other complex generics. With an integrated lab-to-patient 
model, Biocon brings together research and development, manufacturing, and commercial capabilities to ensure 
reliable and scalable supply of medicines. The company operates in more than 120 countries, supported by seven 
manufacturing sites, three R&D sites, 18 offices worldwide, and a workforce of over 9,500 employees. Biocon has 
been included in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook 2026 for the fourth consecutive year, underscoring its

PRESS RELEASE  
 
Biocon Q2FY27 Total Income at Rs 4,423 Cr; 
EBITDA at Rs 865 Cr; Net Profit at Rs 41 Cr; Biopharma Revenue Up 5% 
 
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India: November 4, 2026: 
 
Biocon Limited (BSE code: 532523, NSE: BIOCON), an innovation-led global biopharmaceuticals 
company, today announced its consolidated financial results for the fiscal second quarter ended 
September 30, 2026. 
FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE 
• 
Consolidated operating revenue increased 
2% YoY to Rs 4,389 crore. 
• 
Biopharma revenue increased 5% YoY to Rs 
3,583 crore. 
o Biosimilars revenue increased 3% YoY to 
Rs 2,809 crore. 
o Generics revenue increased 10% YoY Rs 
774 crore. 
• 
Services revenue increased 13% QoQ to Rs 
833 crore. 
 
Note: Revenue contribution as a % of Revenue 
from Operations  
• 
Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs 865 crore.  
• 
Interest cost continued to trend lower during the quarter, declining 12% YoY to Rs 240 crore, 
following the actions taken to strengthen the balance sheet.  
• 
Net Profit before exceptional items was Rs 44 crore. 
• 
Secured a landmark 10-year biosimilar Pertuzumab PDP partnership in Brazil valued at ~USD 400 
million. 
 
LEADERSHIP COMMENTS 
“Biocon continued to achieve industry firsts in biosimilars, with our Pertuzumab becoming the first 
monoclonal antibody biosimilar recommended under the EMA’s new tailored clinical development 
pathway. This represents an important milestone for biosimilar innovation and patient access. The 
operationalization of our second Insulin Glargine fill-finish line in Malaysia, with commercial supplies 
already underway, further reaffirms our global manufacturing excellence. Together with our continued 
investments in technology and innovation, these milestones reflect the progress of our strategic 
transformation and reinforce our confidence in Biocon’s long-term growth trajectory.” 
 – Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, Executive Chairperson, Biocon Limited 
 
“This quarter we continued to make significant progress on our strategic priorities, laying the foundation 
for a stronger second half of FY27. Our global settlement with Genentech for Pebrilzo® (biosimilar 
Pertuzumab) secured the earliest licensed launch dates across Europe, UK, the U.S. and emerging 
markets providing greater visibility to a significant future growth driver. We also secured a landmark 10-
year Pertuzumab PDP partnership in Brazil valued at ~USD 400 million, underscoring our ability to win 
and execute large-scale biologics deals. 
Together with the upcoming European launch of Pertuzumab, expanded insulin manufacturing capacity 
in Malaysia to support growing U.S. demand, and the strong early momentum of Yesafili™ and Yesintek® 
in the U.S., we are well positioned for growth in the second half of FY27.” 
– Shreehas Tambe, CEO & Managing Director, Biocon Limited  

 
 
                              
2 
 
 
“Syngene delivered 13% sequential revenue growth in Q2, supported by positive traction in our CDMO 
business, with operating EBITDA margin improving by 6 percentage points. Year-on-year revenue 
declined 9%, while operating EBITDA margin stood at 18%, in line with expectations, primarily reflecting 
lower Zoetis revenues and forex hedge losses.  
A key milestone in the quarter was the signing of our first manufacturing agreement for the Bayview 
biologics facility in the U.S. Our focus remains on improving our integrated drug discovery offering, 
commercial execution, asset utilization and cost competitiveness to drive sustainable growth.”   
– Siddharth Mittal, CEO & Managing Director, Syngene International Limited

About Biocon Limited  
Biocon Limited (BSE: 532523, NSE: BIOCON) is a global biopharmaceutical company driven by its purpose to 
provide affordable, life-changing medicines to patients worldwide. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Biocon 
addresses some of the world’s most pressing healthcare challenges across chronic and non-communicable 
diseases by offering both biosimilars and generics at scale across geographies. Through this diversified portfolio, 
Biocon focuses on areas of high unmet need, spanning key therapy areas including diabetes, oncology, obesity, 
cardiovascular diseases, immunology, ophthalmology, and bone health. The company has pioneered several 
industry firsts that have helped shape the global biosimilars landscape. To date, the company has commercialized 
12 biosimilar products and 30+ generic formulations globally. It has robust research and development pipeline of 
20 biosimilar assets, as well as GLP-1 peptides and other complex generics. With an integrated lab-to-patient 
model, Biocon brings together research and development, manufacturing, and commercial capabilities to ensure 
reliable and scalable supply of medicines. The company operates in more than 120 countries, supported by seven 
manufacturing sites, three R&D sites, 18 offices worldwide, and a workforce of over 9,500 employees. Biocon has 
been included in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook 2026 for the fourth consecutive year, underscoring its 
commitment to sustainable and responsible growth. Website: www.biocon.com Follow us on X: @bioconlimited 
LinkedIn: Biocon 
 
About Syngene International Ltd.  
Syngene International Ltd. (BSE: 539268, NSE: SYNGENE, ISIN: INE 398R01022) is an integrated research, 
development, and manufacturing services company serving the global pharmaceutical, biotechnology, nutrition, 
animal health, consumer goods, and specialty chemical sectors. Syngene’s team of over 5,600 scientists brings 
both deep expertise and the capacity to deliver scientific excellence, robust data security, and world class 
manufacturing, at speed, to improve time-to-market and lower the cost of innovation. With 2.5+ mn sq. ft of 
specialized discovery, development, and manufacturing facilities, Syngene works with around 400 global 
customers across industry segments, including biotech companies pursuing leading-edge science and 
multinationals such as BMS, GSK, Zoetis, and Merck KGaA. For more details, visit www.syngeneintl.com . For the 
Company’s latest Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) report, visit Syngene ESG Report.

the new businesses where the capacities are coming in?  
Abhishek Pareek: 
So, Praveen, if you look at our investment in all of these verticals, most of the capex are getting 
completed this year except the second phase of battery, which is 16.5, which is under planning 
stage. And the glass, which is in the planning stage, ingot-wafer of course.  
 
But most of these investments are starting to give their revenue as well as bottom line starting 
from Q1 FY '28. So throughout FY '28, we shall be seeing both the support from these new 
investments including transformers, T&D, new facilities of cell, electrolyzers, inverter.  
 
As a percentage of overall revenue, we have not given a guidance so far how much will come 
from this, but I can help you out with that, where directionally are we moving. Solar panel 
module business always happened to be around 95% to 96% of our revenues few years back. It 
has come down to around 80% to 85% recently.  
 
Going ahead, it seems that with the higher growth in newer business verticals where we are 
investing around Rs. 30,000 crores, over 2.5 years, the contribution shall rise from 15%-20% 
from these businesses to around 30% to 35% over next 2 to 3 years.  
 
So in a longer range, solar business share of the total revenue in terms of percentage may come 
down, though absolute value will keep on increasing because of the higher utilization of volumes 
across Indian facilities as well as US facilities. So, 50% to 60% could remain the pure-play solar 
business revenue streams in long range, 2 to 3 years. Around 40% to 45% could be the range of 
revenue from these segments including the battery energy storage predominantly, plus the EPC 
and T&D businesses and supported by transformers, inverters, and electrolyzers. Hope this gives 
you some color.

Yes, thank you for that. Just to further on this question, the BESS facility, or especially the BESS 
cell capacity, which is 3.5 gigawatt-hour, what is the status? That is also going to be alive from 
the Q1 '28?

Dabur Reports 11. 7% Growth in Q2 Net Profit at ~SOS Crore, 
4th consecutive quarter of double-digit profit growth 
Consolidated Revenue Grows 11.6% to "3,563 Crore; 
India FMCG Business Grows 10. 7%; International Business Grows 20% 
New Delhi, August 4th, 2026: Dabur India Limited, one of India's leading FMCG companies, 
announced its results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. 
Key Highlights: 
• 
Consolidated Revenue: Q2 Revenue Grew 11.6% to ,3,563 crore - 2nd straight quarter 
of double-digit growth; Hl Revenue at ,7,327 crore, 11.1% growth. 
• 
Net Profit: Q2 PAT rose 11.7% to '505 crore - 4th consecutive quarter of double-digit 
profit growth; Hl PAT at ,1,096 Crore, up 13.4%. 
• 
India FMCG Business: 10.7% growth, with 5.5% underlying volume growth. 
• 
Premiumisation: Premium brands grew at 4X the pace of regular brands and accounts 
for 20% share of the domestic business. 
• 
International Business: Grew 20% in INR terms in Q2, with strong performances across 
key markets. Hl International business up 19.4%. 
Dabur's performance reflected the underlying strength of its core brands, continued 
momentum in the premium portfolio, and focused execution across categories. 
Commenting on the business performance, Dabur India Limited Chief Executive Officer 
Mr. Herjit S. Bhalla said: 
"Our performance in Q2 reflects the strength of our brands and the sharper execution of our 
strategy. We delivered profitable growth despite operating in a challenging · external 
environment marked by geopolitical uncertainty and elevated input-cost pressures. What gives 
me confidence is that the growth has been broad-based and backed by healthy underlying 
volumes." 
"The evolving channel landscape continues to present significant opportunities for us. This 
quarter saw a marked resurgence in General Trade with the channel growing by mid to high 
single digit, supported by our continued efforts under Project Saksham. We remain focused on 
strengthening our brands and expanding our presence across channels to sustain growth 
momentum," Mr. Bhalla said. 
Category Growths 
The Home & Personal Care (HPC) business grew 10.9% during Q2, led by strong performances 
in hair care and home care, alongside steady growth across skin and oral care categories. Both 

the Shampoo and Hair Oils businesses registered high double-digit growths, while the Home 
Care category also grew in double digits. The Skin & Salon business grew at high single digit 
and the Oral Care category reported mid-single-digit growth. The Healthcare business grew 
6.9% during the quarter, supported by continued momentum in Digestives, OTC & Ethicals 
businesses with these categories reporting strong double-digit growth. The Food & Beverages 
(F&B) business grew 17.4% during the quarter, supported by strong performance in Foods and 
the Beverages portfolio registering a sequential recovery. 
Dabur's International Business grew 20% in INR terms during the quarter, supported by strong 
performances across several key markets like Bangladesh, Egypt, Sub-Saharan Africa and 
Turkey. 
The Board of Directors of Dabur India Ltd declared an Interim Dividend of 350% for 2026-27. 
"Continuing with our payout policy, the Board has declared an Interim Dividend of ,3.50 per 
share, aggregating to a total payout of '620.88 Crore," Dabur India Ltd Chairman Mr. Moh it 
Burman said.

Dabur India Limited is one of India's leading FMCG Companies. Building on a legacy of quality 
and experience for 142 years, Dabur's products today reach 8 out of every 10 Indian 
households, which is a testament to the trust we have built over generations. Our portfolio 
today includes four ,1,000 crore-plus brands, alongside four '500-1,000 crore brands and 15 
brands in the '100-500 crore range.

Sub: Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 04, 2026: Unaudited Financial and 
Segment-wise Results for the quarter and half vear ended September 30, 2026 and 
declaration of Interim Dividend for the Financial Year 2026-27 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
In Compliance with Regulations 30, 33, 43 and 52(4) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, ('Listing Regulations'), we would like to inform that the Board 
of Directors of the Company, in its meeting held today i.e. November 04, 2026, has inter-alia, 
approved the following: 
i) Un-audited Financial and Segment wise results of the Company (Consolidated and 
Standalone), for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026, Cash Flow Statement 
for the half year ended on September 30, 2026, and Statement of Assets and liabilities as at 
that date (Consolidated and Standalone) as recommended by Audit Committee and also taken 
on record the Limited Review Reports issued on such Financial Results by the Statutory 
Auditors of the Company. The said Financial Results and Limited Review Reports issued by 
Statutory Auditors, are being submitted herewith. 
It is hereby confirmed that the Statutory Auditors have issued the Limited Review Report on 
Unaudited Financial Results (Consolidated as well as Standalone) with an unmodified opinion. 
ii) Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 43 of the Listing Regulations, the Board of Directors of the 
Company have declared an Interim Dividend of Rs. 3.50 per equity share having face value of 
Re.1/- each (i.e. 350%) for the financial year 2026-27. 
Pursuant to Regulation 42 of the Listing Regulations, the Company has vide its letter dated 
November 3, 2026 informed to Stock Exchanges regarding the Record Date of Tuesday, 
November 10, 2026, fixed for ascertaining the names of Members/Beneficial Owners entitled 
to receive the Interim Dividend on equity shares for the Financial Year 2026-27.

Independent Auditor's Review Report on Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for 
the Quarter and Half Year ended on 30 September 2026 
To the Board of Directors of Dabur India Limited 
1. 
We have reviewed the accompanying statement of unaudited consolidated financial results 
('the Statement') of Dabur India Limited ('the Holding Company') and its subsidiaries (the 
Holding Company and its subsidiaries together referred to as 'the Group') and its joint 
venture (refer Annexure 1 for the list of subsidiaries and joint venture included in the 
Statement) for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 and the consolidated year to date 
results for the period 01 April 2026 to 30 September 2026, being submitted by the Holding 
Company pursuant to the requirements of Regulation 33 and Regulation 52 read with 
Regulation 63 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 (as amended), including relevant circulars issued by the SEBI from time to time. 
2. 
This Statement, which is the responsibility of the Holding Company's management and 
approved by the Holding Company's Board of Directors, has been prepared in accordance 
with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard 
34, Interim Financial Reporting ('Ind AS 34'), prescribed under section 133 of the 
Companies Act, 2013 ('the Act'), and other accounting principles generally accepted in India 
and is in compliance with the presentation and disclosure requirements of Regulation 33 
and Regulation 52 read with Regulation 63 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (as amended), including relevant circulars issued by the 
SEBI from time to time. Our responsibility is to issue a report on the Statement based on 
our review. 
3. 
We conducted our review of the Statement in accordance with the Standard on Review 
Engagements (SRE) 2410, Review of Interim Financial Information performed by the 
Independent Auditor of the Entity, issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. 
A review of interim financial information consists of making inquiries, primarily of persons 
responsible for financial and accounting matters, and applying analytical and other review 
procedures. A review is substantially less in scope than an audit conducted in accordance 
with the Standards on Auditing specified under section 143(10) of the Act, and 
consequently, does not enable us to obtain assurance that we would become aware of all 
significant matters that might be identified in an audit. Accordingly, we do not express an 
audit opinion.

1. The above financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of 
Directors of Redington Limited (the "Company") on November 4, 2026. The limited review of unaudited 
standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended I half year ended September 30, 2026 
has been carried out by the statutory auditors. 
2. The above financial results comprise the financial results of the Company and its subsidiaries (collectively 
referred to as the 'Group') and the Group's interest in its associate. 
3. 
The above financial results have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement 
principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard 34 "Interim Financial Reporting" ("Ind AS 34"), 
prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and other accounting principles generally 
accepted in India and in compliance with Regulation 33 and Regulation 52(4) of the Securities and 
Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("Listing 
Regulations"). 
4. 
Disclosure of reportable segments, "SISA" (Singapore, India & South Asia) and "ROW' (Rest of the 
World) have been made in a manner consistent with internal reporting to the Managing Director and 
Group Chief Executive Officer who is the Chief Operating Decision Maker ("CODM") for the Group, in line 
with provisions of Ind AS 108, Operating Segment. 
5. During the quarter ended September 30, 2026: 
i. 
The following step-down subsidiaries (wholly owned) have been incorporated: 
• 
Aladeem Al Ah mar for Computer and Mobile Phone Trading and Services LLC was 
incorporated in Iraq. 
• 
Redington Africa SEZ Limited was incorporated in Kenya. 
ii. 
The Company's wholly owned subsidiary, Redington Gulf FZE (RGF) carried out an impairment 
of the trade name classified as an intangible asset arising from its investment in its subsidiary in 
Turkey, Arena Bilgisayar Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S (Arena). 
Based on the assessment, considering the continued challenging economic environment and 
updated future projections, an additional impairment loss of~ 80.33 crores has been recognized 
and disclosed as an Exceptional Item in the above financial results. The impact on the 
Consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) attributable to the shareholders of the Company, after 
considering non-controlling interests, is ~39.68 crores. 
6. The Company is continuing to assess the evolving situation in the Middle East to mitigate any prospective 
risks to its global footprint. For this purpose, the Company considered internal and external sources of 
information up to the date of approval of these financial results. Currently, while the operations are 
dynamically adapting to the ongoing situation, the Company does not foresee any material adverse 
effects on its financial position resulting from the gee-political conflict. The Company will continue to 
monitor developments and take appropriate measures, as necessary, ·to mitigate any potential risks. 
7. Ind AS 29, "Financial Reporting in Hyperinflationary Economies", has been applied in respect of certain 
step-down subsidiaries having "Turkish Lira" as functional currency. The impact on the consolidated 
financial results is not significant.

+ Interest expenses- Interest income earned on surplus funds) I (Interest expenses- Interest income 
earned on surplus funds). 
(c) Debt equity ratio = (Total debt - Cash and cash equivalents and other bank balances - Short term 
investments) I (Total equity- Investments in subsidiaries) 
(d) Net worth= Equity share capital+ Other equity 
(e) Current ratio= Current assets/ Current liabilities 
(f) Current liabilities ratio= Current liabilities/ Total liabilities 
(g) Long term debt to Working capital = Long term borrowings (including current portion of long-term 
borrowings)/ Working capital 
Working capital = Current assets (excluding Assets classified as held for sale) - Current liabilities 
(excluding current maturities of long term debt, interest accrued on borrowings). 
(h) Bad debts to Accounts receivable ratio= Bad debts/ Trade receivables 
(i) Total debts to Total assets ratio= (Non-current borrowings+ Current borrowings)/ Total assets 
U) Debtors turnover ratio (number of times) (annualized) = Revenue from operations / Average Trade 
receivables 
(k) Inventory turnover ratio (number of times) (annualized) = (Purchases of traded goods + Changes in 
inventories of traded goods) / Average Inventories 
(I) Operating margin (%) = (Profit before tax + Finance costs - Dividend income) I Revenue from 
operations 
(m) Net profit margin (%) = Net profit after tax excluding dividend income I Revenue from operations

principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard 34 "Interim Financial Reporting" ("Ind AS 34"), 
prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and other accounting principles generally 
accepted in India and in compliance with Regulation 33 and Regulation 52(4) of the Securities and

Aladeem Al Ah mar for Computer and Mobile Phone Trading and Services LLC was 
incorporated in Iraq. 
• 
Redington Africa SEZ Limited was incorporated in Kenya. 
ii. 
The Company's wholly owned subsidiary, Redington Gulf FZE (RGF) carried out an impairment 
of the trade name classified as an intangible asset arising from its investment in its subsidiary in 
Turkey, Arena Bilgisayar Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S (Arena). 
Based on the assessment, considering the continued challenging economic environment and 
updated future projections, an additional impairment loss of~ 80.33 crores has been recognized 
and disclosed as an Exceptional Item in the above financial results. The impact on the 
Consolidated Profit After Tax (PAT) attributable to the shareholders of the Company, after 
considering non-controlling interests, is ~39.68 crores. 
6. The Company is continuing to assess the evolving situation in the Middle East to mitigate any prospective 
risks to its global footprint. For this purpose, the Company considered internal and external sources of 
information up to the date of approval of these financial results. Currently, while the operations are 
dynamically adapting to the ongoing situation, the Company does not foresee any material adverse 
effects on its financial position resulting from the gee-political conflict. The Company will continue to 
monitor developments and take appropriate measures, as necessary, ·to mitigate any potential risks. 
7. Ind AS 29, "Financial Reporting in Hyperinflationary Economies", has been applied in respect of certain 
step-down subsidiaries having "Turkish Lira" as functional currency. The impact on the consolidated 
financial results is not significant.

PRESS RELEASE 
GE Shipping takes delivery of 2015 built Kamsarmax Dry Bulk Carrier 
“Jag Amit” 
 
On 4th November, The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited (GE Shipping) took delivery of 
2015 built Kamsarmax Dry Bulk Carrier “Jag Amit” of about 81,886 dwt. The company had 
contracted to buy the vessel in Q2 FY27. This vessel is financed entirely from internal accruals. 
 
After this transaction, the company’s current owned fleet stands at 41 vessels, comprising 25 
Tankers (5 Crude Tankers, 16 Product Tankers, 4 LPG Carriers) and 16 Dry Bulk Carriers (2 
Capesize, 11 Kamsarmax, 1 Ultramax, 2 Supramax) aggregating 3.33 mn dwt. The Company’s 
current capacity utilization is close to 100%. 
 
Additionally, the Company has contracted to buy one secondhand Kamsarmax dry bulk carrier 
and one secondhand Very Large Gas Carrier (VLGC), with both transactions expected to be 
completed in Q3 FY27. Furthermore, the Company has entered into a contract for the acquisition 
of a newbuilding Suezmax tanker, which is scheduled for delivery in the second half of FY 2028–
29. 
Place: MUMBAI 
Date: 4th November 2026

Key business highlights  
 
• 
A strong Q2 performance, supported by healthy demand, continued benefits of GST 2.0 
reforms, lower base and stronger execution of the ‘One Exide’ operating model. 
• 
During Q2, standalone revenues grew 20.3% YoY to Rs. 5,026 Crore. 
• 
On a YoY basis, input costs remained elevated due to prolonged geopolitical challenges. On 
a QoQ basis, full benefit of softer Lead LME and antimony prices could not be realized due to 
weaker Rupee. 
• 
Cost optimisation initiatives, along with calibrated price increase and volume growth enabled 
Q2 EBITDA margin expansion by 270 bps YoY. 
• 
Liquidity position remains robust with zero debt and a healthy cash flow generation.

Key information about businesses 
•
Growth momentum remained broad-based in Q2 FY27, with double-digit growth across key
businesses.
•
Automotive OEM business delivered over 25% YoY growth for the 4th consecutive quarter, with
key new launch wins:
o
MG Hector Tomahawk: 100% SOB (share of business) for the Exide auxiliary battery,
on both EV and PHEV.
o
Tata Aeris: 100% SOB in CNG models.
•
2W/4W Replacement business delivered double-digit growth for the 4th consecutive quarter,
driven by steady aftermarket demand.
•
Home Inverters and Solar delivered 20%+ YoY growth for the 2nd consecutive quarter, where 
favourable seasonal demand and Government schemes continued to support Home UPS and
Rooftop solar adoption, respectively.
•
Exports business grew 20%+ YoY for the 2nd consecutive quarter, on a low base. The Company
signed a long-term strategic cooperation agreement with ExCom Energy Solutions GmbH,
Germany, to grow its industrial battery and energy storage business across the European
Economic Area.
Other key updates 
•
The Company infused Rs. 550 Crores of equity into Exide Energy Solutions Limited (EESL)
between April 2026 and October 2026, taking the cumulative equity investment to Rs. 5,352
crores.
•
On 23rd September 2026, EESL completed the commissioning of 6 GWh of lithium-ion cell
gigafactory in Bengaluru.

  
 
Exide Industries Limited, Exide House, 59E Chowringhee Road, Kolkata-700 020 
Phone: (033) 2302-3400, 2283-2171, 2283-2118 
e-mail : exideindustrieslimited@exide.co.in, www.exideindustries.com

Commenting on the performance, Mr. Avik Roy, MD & CEO, said:  
 
"We have sustained our growth momentum in the second quarter, with most of the businesses 
growing in double digits. Demand held up well across our end-markets, as the affordability 
benefits of GST rationalisation continued. We were further aided by favourable seasonal 
demand for Home UPS business. Growth opportunities remain encouraging across Automotive 
OEMs, Replacement, Home Inverters, Solar, Infrastructure and Exports. 
 
The Automotive OEM business grew by over 25% for the fourth consecutive quarter, and the 
2W/4W Replacement business sustained its double-digit growth. Home Inverters and Solar also 
had a strong quarter, growing over 20%. Exports grew by over 20% YoY on a low base, and our 
long-term strategic cooperation agreement with ExCom Energy Solutions GmbH, Germany, 
strengthens our presence in the European Economic Area. 
 
Input costs remained elevated vs last year, due to prolonged geopolitical challenges, especially 
across West Asia. Crude oil prices went up significantly, resulting in an overall inflationary 
environment. On a sequential quarter basis, the full benefits of softer Lead LME and antimony 
prices could not be fully realized due to continuous weakening of Rupee against US Dollar. 
 
The Company undertook various cost optimisation initiatives to absorb this cost pressure. 
Further, calibrated price increase and operating leverage enabled EBITDA margin expansion in 
Q2 and H1 of FY27. 
 
We enter the festive season with healthy demand indicators. At the same time, we remain 
mindful of the high base of last year's post-GST demand surge as well as continue to closely 
monitor input costs. 
 
23rd September 2026 marked a defining milestone in our New Energy business’ journey, as EESL 
completed the commissioning of 6 GWh of lithium-ion cell gigafactory in Bengaluru. Our focus 
over the coming quarters is on stabilising the lines, improving yields and completing customer 
qualifications. These achievements reinforce our confidence in building a strong foundation in 
the New Energy business."

About Exide Industries Limited 
For close to eight decades, Exide has been one of India's most reliable battery brands, enjoying 
strong reputation and brand recall. Exide designs, manufactures, markets, and sells the widest 
range of lead acid storage batteries in the world from 2.5Ah to 20,200Ah capacity, to cover the 
broadest spectrum of applications. The batteries are manufactured for Automotive, Power, 
Telecom, Infrastructure projects, UPS systems as well as for Railways, Mining, and Defence 
sectors. The company enjoys leadership position in India and its exports span 70+ countries 
across six continents. 
Exide, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Exide Energy Solutions Limited (“EESL”), completed 
the commissioning of 6 GWh of its greenfield lithium-ion cell manufacturing facility in Bengaluru 
in September 2026. The project is scalable up to 12 GWh catering to both LFP and NMC 
chemistries. The facility is designed to serve India’s electric mobility and stationary energy 
storage markets. Its existing module and pack facility at Prantij, Gujarat has helped build early 
market presence and customer engagement in lithium-ion solutions.
