Ranvir Singh: 
Thank you, Mehak. Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to Kissht’s Q2 FY27 Earnings call. 
Let me start with a simple thought. Lending is one of the oldest businesses in the world, but 
the way we practice it, is decidedly new. We have compressed what traditionally took days into 
a matter of minutes. Today, a customer can go from the first tap on a phone to money in their 
bank account in just a few minutes. Behind that simplicity sits years of investment, across data 
science, AI, machine learning, underwriting intelligence, and technology-led collections. What 
looks effortless to the customer is enormous complexity behind the scenes. And that, in many 
ways, is the essence of what we have built at Kissht. In lending, one good quarter proves very 
little. Growth is remarkably easy to achieve: just lower your standards, and the applause comes 
immediately, but the reckoning comes later. So the only honest measure of a lender is 
consistency, which means growing without loosening credit standards, and earning without 
shortcuts… quarter after quarter. This quarter for us, registered users reached 79.5 million, up 
32.6% year-on-year. We have now served 12.8 million customers, up 22.5%. AUM reached Rs. 
9,317 crore, up 68.4% year-on-year, and 16.4% quarter on quarter. Profit after tax was Rs. 125 
crore, double of what we earned a year ago, and 31.6% above last quarter. Return on average 
AUM was 5.78%. We believe growth without profitability is, expensive ambition, while 
profitability without growth is comfortable stagnation. The real achievement is to deliver both 
-  not at the expense of tomorrow, but on the strength of what we built today.  
On the macro picture, India's economy remains remarkably resilient, despite an unsettled 
world. GDP grew 7.8% in the first quarter, and the RBI has raised its FY27 growth forecast to 
7.1%. Despite a below-average monsoon and some softness in urban discretionary spends, 
consumption is turning up. FMCG value growth hit a six-quarter high of 8.6% in Q2. The festive 
season and industry tell the same story. E-commerce festive season sales are up 20-22%. 
Electricity consumption rose 11.4% in September, a strong signal of industrial activity. Further, 
GST collection is up 14% year-on-year. At the same time, the RBI has raised the repo rate by 25 
basis points to 5.50%, in what is clearly a calibrated tightening. The message is clear : Growth 
remains robust, but money is getting dearer. Even as borrowing costs rise across the system, 
our cost of borrowing has fallen by approximately 70 basis points, from 14.45% to 13.76%. The 
total finance cost, as a share of average AUM, has also fallen by 100 basis points quarter on 
quarter. Policy tightening may slow this improvement, but we do not expect it to reverse the 
trend, and we will continue to see reduction in our cost of fund for future. On regulation, the 
proposed IRDAI changes on insurance commissions and loan-link insurance have drawn a lot 
of attention. Insurance is less than 1.4% of our total income, our offerings have always been 
voluntary, and we expect no material impact on earnings.  

  
 
 
 
 
    OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited  
 
 
October 29, 2026 
 
Page 3 of 18 
 
We also welcome the RBI's move to make account aggregators interoperable by December 
2026. In lending, better information is not merely an advantage, it is the foundation of better 
judgment. Consent-based access to verified financial data will make our underwriting both 
faster and more precise. The macro environment offers reasons for confidence, but none for 
complacency. Our priorities remain unchanged, which is basically disciplined underwriting, 
prudent funding, and sustainable growth.  
Let me turn to what we are seeing in the retail credit market. Across the industry, retail loan 
sanctions are up by nearly 20% year-on-year. Lenders are favoring larger loans and better 
quality borrowers, and the share of below-prime and new-to-credit customers is falling. Yet, as 
per Bureau, the industry Retail credit balances have grown 19%, while the number of 
borrowers has grown less than 9%. The implication is clear, indebtedness is rising far faster 
than the borrower base. That warrants close attention. At Kissht, we have been moving 
deliberately in the opposite direction, which is going after less leveraged customers. The share 
of new loans to customers with 3 or more live loans has fallen more than 35% over the past 12 
months, and more than 7% quarter on quarter. While the industry's borrowers are getting 
more leveraged, we are steadily lending less to leveraged borrowers. Our shift towards higher 
quality borrowers continues. Loans to customers with bureau scores above 760 has risen from 
20.8% to 24.8%. And only about 4% of our loans go to customer scoring Below 700. Gold loans 
are another example. We flagged rising gold loan exposure as a risk in September 2025, and 13 
months back began restricting lending to consumers carrying gold loan. Which has now come 
down to as low as sub 8% of the total book, with tighter curbs in the North than in the South. 
We've acted well before the industry began worrying about stress in gold loans. Our machine-
learning models continuously flag early signs of stress, and the segments where exposure 
needs to be cut. The objective is simple… act before the stress reaches the balance sheet. And 
let me tell you, this is business as usual for us, not an occasional intervention. This is something 
that we do daily, day in, day out. Our underwriting discipline doesn't depend on a kind credit 
cycle. We tighten early, grow selectively, and lend only where the numbers earn it.  
Talking about key numbers, AUM grew to Rs. 9,317 crore, up 68% year-on-year, 16% quarter-
on-quarter. Disbursements were Rs. 4,612 crore, up 56% year-on-year. AUM is growing faster 
than the disbursement, and that is by design. Our better customers take longer-tenure loans, 
so each rupee we lend stays on the book longer, and with a better quality outcome. Average 
tenure has risen to 17.8 months, and the average ticket to Rs. 43,380. We have a high latitude 
to increase our ticket size. Let me repeat, we have a high latitude to increase our ticket size; 
however, given our overall prudence in limiting customer-level exposure, we have kept it 
deliberately moderate.

active customers grew 58% year-on-year to 3.61 million. Total income was Rs. 740 crore, up 
43% year-on-year. As a share of average AUM, it moved from 35.9% to 34.2% quarter on 
quarter. That reflects our relentless focus on better-credit worthy customers. And as our own 
costs fall, we share part of the gain with our customers, which attracts even better borrowers.

and foremost, Our app sourcing, is geared towards going after customers who have income 
levels at least 20-30% higher than what we have done in the past. So, for example, there is a 
big campaign that we run where the income level of the customer is greater than 1 lakh. These 
are a combination of salaried and self-employed. If it is a salaried person, it is mostly working 
in a decent, mid-size, sometimes even a corporate, company. These are specific campaigns that 
we run on, these set of customers. We also see an overlap between these customers and who 
are basically non-revolvers in credit card. So, I'm just giving one example, but that is one big 
segment that we go after, through App. Just within that app, I should also mention, we have,

JBM Electric Vehicles launches Electric City Bus — ECOLIFE e12 
at Singapore Urban Mobility Week 2026 
Nov 4, 2026| Singapore: JBM Electric Vehicles (JBM EV), a global leading electric bus manufacturer and EV 
Ecosystem player launched its all-electric city bus - ECOLIFE e12 today at the Singapore Urban Mobility Week 
(SUMW) 2026. The bus was launched by Dr. Shilpak Ambule, High Commissioner of India to the Republic of 
Singapore in the presence of Mr. Nishant Arya, Chairman, JBM Electric Vehicles. JBM Electric Vehicles is the 
flagship company of the $4.0 billion global Indian conglomerate, JBM Group. 
JBM EV brings in the agility and innovation of an established global leader with the proven scale, 
manufacturing muscle and international expertise. The company offers its customers a low-risk, high-reward 
propositioni.e. cutting-edge e-bus technology with thousands of units of proven real-world reliability, backed 
by one of the largest dedicated manufacturing capacity of 20,000 buses per annum and a commitment to 
exceptional local support all at a highly competitive value. 
The ECOLIFE citybus comes with a light weight monocoque full aluminium body structure and equipped with 
state-of-the-art features including Intelligent Transport System as per all Singapore regulations, advanced 
telematics giving 24x7 access to vehicle’s state of health amongst host of other features. 
JBM ECOLIFE is equipped with the Advanced Driver-Assistance System (ADAS) technology that assists the 
driver detect obstacles and checks driver errors for utmost safe transit. A host of other additional safety 
features include, Forward vehicle collision warning systems (FVCWS), Lane Departure Warning System, 
Pedestrian and cyclist collision warning (MOIS), Blind spot detection, protection of vehicle against cyber- 
attack, driver drowsiness, attention warning and advance driver distraction warning and Fire detection & 
suppression system FDSS, 360 degrees camera, etc. 
Speaking at the occasion, Mr. Nishant Arya, Chairman, JBM Electric Vehicles (P) Ltd. said, " Our mission is to 
decarbonize public transport by creating new and sustainable global benchmarks. At JBM EV, we believe that 
the future of green mobility lies in creating vehicles that seamlessly blend innovation, sustainability and user- 
centric design. Our electric mobility solutions are not just about reducing carbon footprints, they are about 
elevating the quality of life for individuals and communities by making transportation smarter, safer, and more 
accessible”. 
“We believe in the power of partnerships and collaboration to continuously improve, listening to the needs of 
our customers to develop solutions to address their pain points. We constantly evolve to provide new ideas 
and solutions in the e-mobility world. We invest to better support our customers by thinking global and acting 
local in meeting the challenges of today and tomorrow”. 
In a strategic move to strengthen its operations, JBM EV has established its APAC headquarters in Singapore. 
This hub will serve as the company’s central base for marketing & sales, aftersales, operations and 
partnerships across the APAC region. 
JBM Electric Vehicles brings to the table a robust orderbook of 10,000 electric buses to be deployed over next 
2years across the globe. The company has set up one of the world's largest dedicated integrated electric bus 
manufacturing facility, located in India, with an annual production capacity of 20,000 electric buses. With 
over 4,000+ electric buses on road across various geographies, JBM electric buses have clocked 500+ million 
e-kms having catered to over 1.5 billion passengers and having saved 650+ billion kgs CO2 emissions till 
date.

ECI-LIFE 
JBM:® 
Our milestones are touchstones 
JBM’s disruptive EV Ecosystem — JBM E-Verse encompasses in-house capabilities in fast charging 
infrastructure, efficient Lithium-ion batteries, energy storage systems, power infrastructure and a network 
that ensures zero downtime. The E-Verse demonstrates the company's commitment towards providing end- 
to-end e-mobility solutions, designed in India for the world. 
JBM Electric Vehicles is ready and uniquely positioned to deliver a seamless, successful electric bus fleet for 
Singapore, powering a cleaner, quieter and more sustainable future for its citizens. 
About JBM Electric Vehicles (P) Ltd. 
JBM Electric Vehicles (P) Ltd., part of the $4.0 bn Indian conglomerate, JBM Group, is the leading electric bus 
and EV ecosystem player globally. The company specialises in manufacturing ultra sophisticated and 
technologically superior zero emission electric buses that have established class leading benchmarks across 
various geographies globally. JBM EV is spearheading the global shift towards electric mobility and the 
company currently offers an extensive portfolio of e-buses ranging from city, intercity, luxury coach, staff, 
school, tarmac and special purpose vehicles. For more info, please visit www.jbmbuses.com. 
IR

Outcome of the meeting of the Board of Directors held on 04th 
November 2026 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
Further to our letter dated 23th October 2026, intimating the exchanges about 
the Board meeting, it is hereby informed that the Board of Directors at its 
meeting held today i.e. Wednesday, 04th November 2026, inter-alia. 
1.
Approved the unaudited financial results (Standalone and Consolidated)
of the Company for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September
2026, along with the Limited Review Report on the said unaudited
financial results from M/s. Walker Chandiok & Co LLP, Statutory Auditors
of the Company, which are enclosed as Annexure-I.
Extract of the aforesaid results will be published in the newspapers in 
the format prescribed under Regulation 47 of the SEBI (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. 
2.
Declared an Interim Dividend of INR  5/- (Rupees Five only) per equity 
share of INR 10/- each for financial year ending 31st March 2027. As 
intimated vide our letter dated 23th October 2026, the record date for 
reckoning the list of shareholders who shall be entitled to receive the 
said interim dividend shall be Thursday, 12th November 2026. The 
Interim Dividend will be paid to such shareholders on or before 
Wednesday, 3rd December 2026.
3.
Approved an investment of z25 crore in its wholly owned subsidiary i.e., 
Metallix Aviation Private Limited as part of its business expansion by 
way of subscription to equity shares in compliance with the applicable 
provisions of the Companies Act, 2013.

Rakesh Verma, Chairman & Managing Director, MapmyIndia, commenting on the Q2 and H1 
FY27 results, said “We are pleased to report another quarter of profitable growth, with 
Revenue from Operations growing 15.8% YoY to ₹131.7 crore in Q2FY27 and 18.4% to ₹271.5 
crore in H1 FY27. Profitability improved significantly, with Q2 EBITDA growing 60.1% to ₹45.0 
crore and PAT increasing 90.6% to ₹35.3 crore. For H1 FY27, EBITDA grew 20.4% to ₹101.1 
crore and PAT increased 32.2% to ₹85 crore. Our strong cash position of ₹730.3 crore further 
reflects the strength and resilience of our business. 
 
Across our three business verticals, Automotive delivered strong YoY growth of 51.9% in Q2 
and 40.4% in H1 FY27, driven by increasing adoption of our integrated Map-led and IoT-led 
mobility solutions. Enterprise also recorded healthy growth of 44.1% in Q2 and 16.5% in H1 
FY27. We continue to see significant business visibility and long-term opportunities across all 
our market and product segments. From a product perspective, Map-led revenue grew 8.9% 
to ₹175.3 crore in H1 FY27, with EBITDA margins remaining strong at 47.1%. IoT-led revenue 
grew an encouraging 29.1% to ₹96.2 crore, while EBITDA increased to ₹18.5 crore from ₹7.9 
crore last year, reflecting higher margin solutions and operating leverage. 
 
  
We are further strengthening our leadership team across technology, product and business to 
support the next phase of growth. In parallel, we are embedding AI, ML and neural networks 
across our map-led and IoT-led platforms, spanning intelligent mapping, navigation, in-vehicle 
intelligence, telematics, analytics and workflow automation. Backed by over three decades of 
technology innovation, proprietary data, deep domain expertise and a differentiated 

 
 
 
 
geospatial and IoT portfolio, we are well positioned to accelerate AI-led innovation, create 
new growth opportunities and drive sustainable, profitable growth.” 
 
 
About MapmyIndia (C.E. Info Systems Ltd) & Mappls 
www.mapmyindia.com / about.mappls.com / www.mappls.com  
C.E. Info Systems Ltd (NSE: MAPMYINDIA; BSE: 543425) is India’s leading deep-tech digital 
map data, geospatial software and location-based IoT products, platforms, solutions and APIs 
company, offering proprietary digital maps as a service ("MaaS"), software as a service 
("SaaS") and platform as a service ("PaaS"). The company provides its digital maps, software 
products, platforms, application programming interfaces (“APIs”), IoT and solutions to new-
age tech companies, businesses across industry verticals, automotive OEMs, government 
organisations, developers and consumers, under the Mappls MapmyIndia brand. The 
company has served more than 2000 B2B and B2B2C customers since inception. The company 
pioneered digital mapping in India in 1995 and has earned its market leadership position in 
this industry and built a strong moat by capitalizing on our early mover advantage, developing 
proprietary and integrated technologies, full stack product offerings, continuous innovation 
and robust sustainable business model. 
MapmyIndia has built India’s most comprehensive, accurate, feature-rich and continuously 
updated digital map data product down to address and urban building level detail pan India, 
covering all towns, villages, and the entire road network of the country. The company is 
building not just 2D maps, but also 3D (with landmarks, terrains and city models), 4D 
(updating in near real-time), HD (high-definition and high-accuracy), RealView (photo-realistic 
representing actual ground reality), and hyper-local geo-demographics data-rich maps, to 
continuously evolve its AI-powered Digital Metaverse Twin of the Real World. The company is 
also building digital maps for other regions in the world, and has integrated global maps for 
over 200 countries into its Mappls platform. The company’s platform provides extensive and 
comprehensive functionalities and ever expanding set of use cases, including mapping, 
location and navigation, geospatial data analytics, GIS (geospatial information systems) and 
AI, GPS tracking and IoT-based fleet management, logistics optimisation and workforce 
management, drone-based solutions, developer APIs, N-CASE solution suite (for Navigation, 
Connected vehicle telematics and services, ADAS safety i.e. advanced driving assistance 
systems, Shared and Electric) for Automotive & Mobility Tech (A&M), and Consumer tech and 
Enterprise digital transformation solution suite (C&E). More about the entire range of the 
company’s products and platforms can be learned about from about.mappls.com.    
The company’s consumer facing products include the free Mappls App (accessible on the web 
at www.mappls.com & downloadable from mappls.com/getApp), which provides the best and 
fully indigenous maps, navigation, safety, hyper local and IoT gadget-enabled app experience 
for users, and Mappls Gadgets (www.mapplsgadgets.com), which provides a range of IoT-
enabled gadgets for safety, convenience, entertainment of your vehicles and loved ones such 
as vehicle trackers, dash cameras, and in-dash and in-helmet navi-tainment systems for cars 
and 2-wheelers.

products, platforms, application programming interfaces (“APIs”), IoT and solutions to new-
age tech companies, businesses across industry verticals, automotive OEMs, government 
organisations, developers and consumers, under the Mappls MapmyIndia brand. The 
company has served more than 2000 B2B and B2B2C customers since inception. The company 
pioneered digital mapping in India in 1995 and has earned its market leadership position in 
this industry and built a strong moat by capitalizing on our early mover advantage, developing 
proprietary and integrated technologies, full stack product offerings, continuous innovation 
and robust sustainable business model. 
MapmyIndia has built India’s most comprehensive, accurate, feature-rich and continuously 
updated digital map data product down to address and urban building level detail pan India, 
covering all towns, villages, and the entire road network of the country. The company is 
building not just 2D maps, but also 3D (with landmarks, terrains and city models), 4D 
(updating in near real-time), HD (high-definition and high-accuracy), RealView (photo-realistic 
representing actual ground reality), and hyper-local geo-demographics data-rich maps, to 
continuously evolve its AI-powered Digital Metaverse Twin of the Real World. The company is 
also building digital maps for other regions in the world, and has integrated global maps for 
over 200 countries into its Mappls platform. The company’s platform provides extensive and 
comprehensive functionalities and ever expanding set of use cases, including mapping, 
location and navigation, geospatial data analytics, GIS (geospatial information systems) and 
AI, GPS tracking and IoT-based fleet management, logistics optimisation and workforce 
management, drone-based solutions, developer APIs, N-CASE solution suite (for Navigation, 
Connected vehicle telematics and services, ADAS safety i.e. advanced driving assistance 
systems, Shared and Electric) for Automotive & Mobility Tech (A&M), and Consumer tech and 
Enterprise digital transformation solution suite (C&E). More about the entire range of the 
company’s products and platforms can be learned about from about.mappls.com.    
The company’s consumer facing products include the free Mappls App (accessible on the web 
at www.mappls.com & downloadable from mappls.com/getApp), which provides the best and 
fully indigenous maps, navigation, safety, hyper local and IoT gadget-enabled app experience 
for users, and Mappls Gadgets (www.mapplsgadgets.com), which provides a range of IoT-
enabled gadgets for safety, convenience, entertainment of your vehicles and loved ones such 
as vehicle trackers, dash cameras, and in-dash and in-helmet navi-tainment systems for cars 
and 2-wheelers.

Thomas Cook India strengthens footprint in Uttar Pradesh 
Opens first outlet in Gorakhpur’s high-potential market  
Expands consumer access to 12 locations across the State 
 
Mumbai, November 4, 2026: In line with its strategic expansion into viable emerging markets, Thomas Cook 
(India) Limited, India’s leading omnichannel services company, has strengthened its network with the 
opening of its first outlet in the city of Gorakhpur. This newly launched outlet broadens the Company’s 
access to 12 outlets across the state of Uttar Pradesh. 
 
Located in Taramandal, South-East Gorakhpur, the outlet is situated in an established commercial and 
residential neighbourhood with a growing base of affluent households, business professionals and 
outbound travellers. Its proximity to key commercial and lifestyle landmarks, coupled with good 
connectivity to surrounding areas, gives it access to a wider customer catchment. The outlet is well-
positioned to cater to diverse customer segments, including multi-generational families, corporate 
professionals, couples, Millennials and Gen Z, as well as GenS (seniors). 
 
The outlet will offer a comprehensive portfolio spanning International and Domestic Holidays, Group Tours, 
Personalised Holidays, Cruises and value-added services such as Travel Insurance. Customers can also 
access Thomas Cook’s AI-powered booking platform, which enables personalised vacation planning by 
checking availability and making reservations in real time. 
 
Gorakhpur/Uttar Pradesh Travel Trends  
 
• 
Year-round travel: Travellers from Gorakhpur are increasingly leveraging public holidays and weekends 
to take multiple short breaks and mini-cations throughout the year, extending travel beyond traditional 
holiday seasons. 
• 
Preference for experiential holidays: Travellers are increasingly looking for holidays that offer distinctive 
experiences and greater personalisation, moving beyond conventional destination-based itineraries. 
• 
Diverse travel formats: Cruise holidays and charter-led journeys are gaining traction among travellers, 
with Thomas Cook India launching exclusive charter flights to Lakshadweep and Bhutan for the year-end 
holiday season. 
• 
Growing demand for pilgrimage and spiritual tourism: Pilgrimage and spiritual travel continue to gain 
momentum, with Thomas Cook India strengthening its Spiritual Tourism portfolio ‘Bhakti’ to cater to this 
growing segment. Key spiritual hubs include Kailash Mansarovar, Char Dham, Vaishnodevi, Ujjain, Puri, 
Kashi and Ayodhya. 
• 
Top destinations: 
o 
International: Europe’s Switzerland, France, Austria, Italy, Spain; the Scandinavian countries of 
Finland, Norway and Sweden; Eastern European destinations such as the Czech Republic and Hungary; 
Australia and New Zealand; South America; Vietnam, Indonesia, China, Japan and South Korea; as 
well as Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore. 
o 
Domestic and Indian subcontinent: Rajasthan, Kerala, Andamans, Lakshadweep, Northeast India, 
and Sri Lanka. 
 
Address Details 
Thomas Cook (India) Limited 
Plot No 4, GDA Corporate Park, 
Opposite Ramgarh Lake, Circuit House Road,  
Taramandal, Gorakhpur 
Uttar Pradesh – 273017 
Contact no: 8291014863  
Email id: GCP.Gorakhpur@thomascook.in 
 

 
 
 
Mr. Rajeev Kale, President & Country Head – Holidays, MICE, Visa, Thomas Cook (India) Limited said, 
"Uttar Pradesh is an important source market for us at Thomas Cook India. The launch of our first outlet 
in Gorakhpur enables us to deepen our presence in the state and strengthen our reach across the region. 
Selected for its strategic location, this new outlet will enhance our ability to serve the growing and diverse 
travel needs of customers, offering convenient access to our services and a wide range of group and 
customised holiday solutions, right at their doorstep. My team and I look forward to co-curating memorable 
holidays for our customers, across destinations in India and overseas.” 
 
About Thomas Cook (India) Limited:  
Set up in 1881, Thomas Cook (India) Limited (TCIL) is the leading omnichannel travel company in the country offering a broad 
spectrum of services including Foreign Exchange, Corporate Travel, MICE, Leisure Travel, Value Added Services, and Visa 
Services. It operates leading B2C and B2B brands including Thomas Cook, SOTC, TCI, SITA, Asian Trails, Allied TPro, 
Australian Tours Management, Desert Adventures, Travel Circle International Limited (TCI 勝景遊), Sterling Holiday Resorts 
Limited, Distant Frontiers, TC Tours, Digiphoto Entertainment Imaging (DEI), Go Vacation, Private Safaris East & South Africa. 
  
As one of the largest travel service provider networks headquartered in the Asia-Pacific region, The Thomas Cook India Group 
spans 28 countries across 5 continents. 
  
TCIL has been felicitated with ET Edge’s Best Organizations for Women (BOW) 2026, MICE Powerhouse at MaxiiiMICE Awards 
2025, Outbound Travel Operator of the Year (2024) and MICE Travel Operator of the Year (2024 & 2023) at The Economic 
Times Travel & Tourism Annual Awards, MICE Travel Agency (Outbound) at the Economic Times MICE & Wedding Tourism 
Awards 2024, 'Masters of Risk - Travel & Hospitality' at India Risk Management Awards 2024, MICE Tour Operator of the Year 
- Outbound at SATTE 2024, Best Tour Operator at India Travel Awards North 2023, winner of the Corporate Citizen Award 
(Travel Tourism & Hospitality) at the Corporate Citizen Conclave & Award 2023, The Outbound Tour Operator of the Year 2022 
at the SATTE Awards, IAMAI India Digital Awards 2022, CNBC-TV18 & ICICI Lombard India Risk Management Award - Travel 
& Leisure Category 2022 & 2021, CIO100 Award for digital innovation 2022. 
 
CRISIL has reaffirmed the rating on debt programs and bank facilities of TCIL - ‘CRISIL AA/Stable’ on the long-term bank 
facilities of TCIL and ‘CRISIL A1+’ rating on the short-term bank facilities and short- term debt of the company. The highest 
rating for a travel & tourism company in India. 
 
For more information, please visit www.thomascook.in  
 
Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) Limited, a subsidiary of Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited, is the promoter of TCIL with a 
shareholding of 64.77% of its paid-up capital. 
 
About Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited:  
Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited is a holding company which, through its subsidiaries, is primarily engaged in property and 
casualty insurance and reinsurance and the associated investment management. Founded in 1985 by the present Chairman 
and Chief Executive Officer, Mr. V. Prem Watsa, the company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Its common shares are 
listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol FFH and in U.S. dollars under the symbol FFH.U. 
 
About Subsidiaries of Thomas Cook (India) Limited (TCIL): 
 
Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited 
Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of TCIL is a leading leisure 
hospitality company with over 78 resorts, hotels and retreats across 48 locations in India covering hills, beaches, jungles, 
waterfront, adventure, heritage, pilgrimage and drive-to locations. Sterling provides a variety of offerings: Leisure holidays 
through FIT packages, Meetings & Conferences, Weddings, Reunions, Picnics and Holidays. 
 
SOTC Travel Limited 
SOTC Travel Limited is a step-down subsidiary of Fairfax Financial Holdings held through its Indian listed subsidiary, Thomas 
Cook (India) Limited (TCIL). SOTC Travel is a leading omnichannel travel and tourism company active across various travel 
segments including Leisure Travel, Incentive Travel and Business Travel.  
Established in 1949, SOTC is an Indian-grown brand with a legacy of over 75 years. Since then, it has escorted millions of 
travellers across the globe to various destinations around the globe. The Company firmly believes that today, ‘No one 
understands the Indian Traveller better than SOTC’. 

 
 
 
Travel Corporation (India) Limited 
Travel Corporation (India) Limited (TCI) (operating brands Sita, TCI and Distant Frontiers), a wholly owned subsidiary of TCIL, 
is the leading Destination Management Company in India that offers tailor-made travel and related services to India, Nepal, 
Bhutan and Sri Lanka. 
 
DEI Holdings Limited 
Thomas Cook India Group holds 51% stake in DEI Holdings Limited (DEI), one of the world’s leading imaging solutions and 
services providers. 
 
For more information, visit:  
Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited: http://www.sterlingholidays.com  
SOTC Travel Limited: http://www.sotc.in

Chennai, 4 November 2026: Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited (SHRL), one of India's leading 
hospitality companies, continued its strong growth trajectory, reporting its 27th consecutive 
proﬁtable quarter and delivering record Q2 revenue of ₹1,272 million, up 17% year-on-year, despite 
the quarter traditionally being the weakest in the hospitality calendar. Q2 EBITDA stood at ₹289 
million, while occupancy improved to 60%, ARR increased 12% to ₹6,494 & Total RevPAR grew 12%.

Sterling recorded its highest-ever quarterly expansion, opening seven resorts in Q2 FY27 and taking 
its portfolio to 83 resorts, crossing the milestone of 4,000 keys. Six additional resort sign-ups during 
the quarter further strengthened its expansion pipeline. 
The managed-resort business is emerging as a signiﬁcant growth driver. Q2 revenue from managed 
resorts grew 67% year-on-year to ₹379 million, contributing 23% of enterprise revenue. With 42 
managed resorts, Sterling is scaling its asset-right model, expanding its footprint across India while 
building a meaningful and growing contribution to overall turnover.

₹2,971 million. EBITDA grew 15% to ₹910 million, while Proﬁt Before Tax increased 22% to ₹623 
million, reﬂecting sustained operating momentum and improving business fundamentals.

Occupancy increased 500 bps to 68%, while ARR rose 11% to ₹7,222. Sterling continued to focus on 
improving revenue productivity and maximising revenue beyond rooms. 
Strong Balance Sheet to Support Growth 
Sterling ended Q2 FY27 with cash reserves of ₹3,805 million, up 12% sequentially, while continuing 
to maintain a zero-debt balance sheet. Operating free cash ﬂow for H1 grew 16% to ₹593 million.

experience and expansion opportunities, while maintaining capital discipline.

Awards 2026 for the third consecutive time. Sterling ONE, its distribution platform, received the 
"Smart Tech Enabled Platform of the Year 2026 – B2B" award at the Indian Travel & Technology 
Summit & Awards 2026.
